title: My Flashcards
text:
I have a box of flashcards. Each card has a word on one side and a picture on the other side. I look at the card and say the word. Then I turn the card over to check the answer.

Flashcards help me learn new words. I study them every day, in the morning. My sister studies with me. We are happy when we know all the words.

questions.text: How many sides does each flashcard have?
How does the writer feel about flashcards?
What does the writer probably want to do?

vocabulary.definition: small cards with a word or picture used for studying
to look at something to see if it is right
the early part of the day

paragraph_translations: Eu tenho uma caixa de cartões de estudo. Cada cartão tem uma palavra de um lado e uma figura do outro lado. Eu olho para o cartão e digo a palavra. Depois eu viro o cartão para verificar a resposta.
Os cartões de estudo me ajudam a aprender palavras novas. Eu estudo todos os dias, de manhã. Minha irmã estuda comigo. Ficamos felizes quando sabemos todas as palavras.
